from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d1d5442c.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1:
            line.update((r,c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            line.update((r,c) for r in range(h))
    for r,c in line:
        g[r][c]=2
    return g
'''
p.write_text(s)
grid=[[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,5,5,5,7,5,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,5,5,5,5,5,5,5],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,5,7,7]]
out=__import__('runpy').run_path(str(p))['transform'](grid)
print(out)
